column7: Hello and welcome to The Toxin Cleanse Diary. Don't skip the supplement adverts. They're healthy, or something.
Anyway, our guest here owns a water company, and he's starting a new brand of creatine-based suppositories.
Water companies dumped sewage in our rivers two hundred and ninety thousand times last year. Is that considered a detox, and can I safely swim?
Two hundred and ninety thousand? Swings and roundabouts at this point. Have you seen my new watch, by any chance?
Where does a man get a million-pound joining bonus when the company's broke?
The answers lie in my new book, The Hidden Benefits of Sewage. Out now.
Our last guest left you a question: how do you sleep at night?
A cocktail of Valium and electrolytes.
Yeah, still here. Nothing yet. Back to you.
